snippet.title: Grand Theft Auto VI Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Vice City, USA.
Jason and Lucia have always known the deck is stacked against them. But when an easy score goes wrong, they find themselves on the darkest side of the sunniest place in America, in the middle of a criminal conspiracy stretching across the state of Leonida — forced to rely on each other more than ever if they want to make it out alive.

Check out the new Launch Trailer, featuring new music from electronic duo Justice, composers of the original score from Grand Theft Auto VI.

The new standalone Justice single, “Flower in a Hurricane” feat. Tame Impala, SZA, and King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard, is also available on Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album, the official soundtrack which is currently available to pre-save on all major music streaming services and up for pre-order on vinyl or CD at https://gtavi-thealbum.com.

Listen to “Flower in a Hurricane” now: https://justice.lnk.to/flowerinahurricane

This trailer was captured entirely in-game from a PlayStation 5.

Grand Theft Auto VI arrives November 19.

snippet.title: A2O LITE - NEON Official Video
snippet.description:
A2O LITE - NEON Official Video

새로운 세대의 감각으로 자신들만의 색을 그려 나가는 9명의 소녀들, A2O LITE가 데뷔 디지털 싱글 'NEON'을 통해 당찬 발걸음을 내딛는다.

동시에 'NEON'은 지금 빛나는 순간에 머무르지 않겠다는 아홉 소녀의 당찬 선언이기도 하다. 꿈꾸는 곳을 향해 나아가고, 그곳에 도달한 뒤에도 멈추지 않고 그 너머 (Beyond)를 바라보겠다는 포부를 담았다.

낯설어서 새롭고, 엉뚱해서 더욱 매력적인 Zalpha Pop.

“Neon and beyond that’s what we on and beyond”

'NEON'은 A2O LITE가 앞으로 펼쳐 나갈 새로운 색과 가능성을 알리는 시작점으로, 그들이 도달할 곳 너머는 어떤 세계일지 기대해봐도 좋을 듯하다.

01. NEON
Composed by Dem Jointz / YOO YOUNG JIN
Lyrics by Dem Jointz / YOO YOUNG JIN
Arranged by Dem Jointz / YOO YOUNG JIN

'NEON'은 A2O LITE가 내세우는 ‘Zalpha Pop’의 정체성을 선명하게 담아낸 곡이다. 묵직하게 울리는 베이스를 중심으로 강렬하고 중독적인 사운드가 펼쳐지며, ‘Neon and beyond’라는 반복적인 가사가 곡 전체를 관통한다.

특히 멤버들의 개성 있는 보컬과 아카펠라, 에너지 넘치는 퍼포먼스가 어우러져 A2O LITE의 자신감과 팀으로서의 시너지를 보여준다.

새로운 빛을 따라 더 높이, 더 멀리 나아가는 A2O LITE의 시작을 알리는 포부를 담았다.

[Credits]
Produced By S.M. LEE
Directed by YOO YOUNG JIN
Assist Directed By Jungwook LEE / Duo XU
Mixed, Recorded, Background Vocal By YOO YOUNG JIN @ LeePollux BOOMINGSYSTEM
Mastered by Namwoo KWON @ 821 Sound Mastering

snippet.description:
You can get Gravestone Griff, an Ultra Chaos Drop, a Buffie OR... 1 Gem?! 😭 

#ScaryCoffins event is LIVE until October 26th for the second Phase of Brawl-O-Ween! 🎈 

EVERY DAY the community needs to complete 100 MILLION Quests together to vote for which coffin to open!

Each coffin hides a different reward 👀 study the coffin AND its headstone for clues, share your theories and solve the mystery together! But BEWARE: some visuals will help you while others will happily lead you straight to disappointment 🪦💀 

Possible rewards:
⚰️ Melodie’s hidden tattoo reveal?! 🤯 
⚰️ 1 Ultra Chaos Drop (that can still split)
⚰️ Gravestone Griff
⚰️ 1 Random Buffie
⚰️ 1 Ultra Trophy Box
⚰️ 1 Coffin Box
⚰️ The Vince Event (arriving early with 2 Vince Boxes)
⚰️ 15 Gems
⚰️ 1 Gem
⚰️ 7 Coins
⚰️ 500 Coins
⚰️ 1000 Coins
⚰️ 500 Power Points
⚰️ 1000 Bling
⚰️ A Player Icon
⚰️ 1 XP Doubler
⚰️ 3 Chaos Drops
⚰️ 5 Chaos Drops
⚰️ 500 Credits
⚰️ 10 Random Starr Drops
⚰️ Prop Hunt in all game modes for 1 day
⚰️ Crow Boss Battle with rewards
⚰️ Kizu Kenji Boss Battle with rewards
⚰️ 1 Chroma Credit

Community will be able to open 12 Coffins during the event with 2 opening on the last day! Which ones? That's up to you! 🫵 

ALSO you can earn a Chaos Drop for correctly predicting a coffin's reward! Tap the square below the coffin to place your guess! Every reveal video has been recorded and we'll post the one matching the coffin with the most votes each day on our socials (ALL videos will be posted after the event ends ⚠️)

🎃 GIVEAWAY 🎃 

We’re giving away 100 Chaos Drops across 10 winners! To participate:
🦇 Share a screenshot of your vote or predictions and explain what you think the reward is and WHY
🦇 Use #BrawlStars and #ScaryCoffins hashtags
🦇 Winners will be contacted after the event ends on October 26th

이 승리로 유럽은 북미 상대 다전제 4연패를 끊었고, 칸나는 타나토스와의 한국인 탑 맞대결에서 웃었습니다. 
이어진 경기에서 퓨리아를 3대0으로 꺾은 베트남의 MVK는 승자조 결승에서 카르민코프와 만납니다.

snippet.title: 🔴 ZOMBIE BRIDGE ARMY LIVE | Type 1 to Join! 🪖 NEW GIANT BOSSES
snippet.description:
🪖 TYPE "1" IN CHAT TO JOIN THE ARMY! 🪖

Welcome to Zombie Bridge Army LIVE – an interactive zombie battle where YOU become a soldier on screen.

✨ BIG NEW UPDATE – GIANT BOSSES
🐸 A brand-new line-up of giant bosses at the end of every level – a monster toad, a T-rex, a huge alligator, a polar bear, a giant octopus, a centipede, a luna moth, a walking cactus, a runaway school bus and more
💥 Bosses burst apart in a storm of toxic green goo when the army wins
🔫 Every weapon rebuilt as a detailed 3D model – pistol → shotgun → minigun → flamethrower → railgun…
🛢️ New detailed barrels, crates, tire stacks, ice blocks, geodes and street lamps along the bridge
🪖 A bigger, brighter army that stands out from the horde
💚 2.5× the goo – every zombie bursts in a bigger splash of green slime

HOW TO PLAY
💬 Type 1 in the live chat → a big soldier with YOUR name and avatar joins the army within seconds.
🔫 Your soldier fights with the whole army – every zombie you take down counts on the 🔫 leaderboard (top 3).
💀 If your soldier falls or the level ends, type 1 again to rejoin.
👥 Up to 20 viewer soldiers fight at the same time – when it's full, you wait in the queue.

💎 SUPER CHAT ALLIES
💎 Super Chat / Super Sticker under $5 → a golden ELITE soldier with your name joins right away
👑 $5+ → your own ally BOSS fights for the army, with your name above it
🔱 $20+ → a TITAN ally boss
(One ally boss on the field at a time – the next one steps in when it falls or at the next level, in order.)
Supporters also get a thank-you banner, confetti and a spot on the 💎 board.

WHAT HAPPENS ON STREAM
🧟 Endless zombie hordes rushing across the bridge
➕ +/- gates that grow or shrink the army
🧊 A giant caged super-ally – free it and it fights right behind the army
👹 A giant boss at the end of every level – VICTORY or DEFEAT?
♾️ Every level is procedurally generated – no two levels are the same.

The more of you join, the stronger the army gets. Type 1 and help the army win!

👍 Like & subscribe so the army never stops marching.

#zombie #livestream #interactive #chatplays #gaming #zombiegame #armyrunner #bossfight #newupdate
